name: Alaa Kjellberg
location: Kenwood Gate, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Alaa Kjellberg is slender the way old buildings are slender â€” not fragile, just built for a different era. He is fifty-two centimeters taller than average and moves with the habitual stoop of someone who has spent decades apologizing for their height in low-ceilinged evidence labs. His skin is a warm amber-brown, his hair white at the temples and worn in short locks threaded with copper wire â€” a fashion choice from his thirties he's never bothered to update. His eyes have patterned irises: geometric gold tessellation that he received as a fortieth-birthday gift to himself and that he occasionally forgets aren't natural when he looks in mirrors.

He is meticulous in the way that conceals other things. The evidence lab at Kenwood Gate is his kingdom, organized by a system only he fully understands, maintained with a devotion that borders on spiritual. He speaks slowly, precisely, and with a lecturer's tendency to answer simple questions with complete historical context. He is not unfriendly â€” he will offer you tea from his personal supply and remember your name the next time you visit â€” but his real warmth is reserved for data: for the story that physical evidence tells, for the satisfaction of a chain of custody without gaps. He has been quietly falsifying minor procedural timestamps for a Tessera internal affairs officer for eighteen months and has not let himself think clearly about why.

core_fears: being responsible for an innocent person's conviction through his own error
that the institution he's given his life to is irredeemably corrupt
core_desires: for evidence to mean something â€” for truth to have weight in a world that keeps discounting it
to finish his career without having done catastrophic harm
coping_mechanisms: intellectualizing moral problems until they become abstract
strong tea and data-prayer to the E.L.F. he believes inhabits the evidence catalog system
blind_spots: he has rationalized the timestamp falsifications as protecting a greater truth; he has not examined who is using them or why
his faith in process blinds him to how process can be weaponized
psychology.secret: The internal affairs officer he's been helping is building a case â€” but not against Tessera wrongdoing. She's constructing false evidence to convict a labor organizer in the Ironvein district. Kasimir has suspected this for two months and has done nothing because he cannot afford to be wrong about her.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, technical when discussing work; surprisingly literary when comfortable â€” quotes older legal texts and occasionally pre-Meridian court transcripts
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate and unhurried, with long subordinate clauses; builds to conclusions methodically
verbal_tics: 'Technically speaking...' as a preamble to corrections
pauses mid-sentence to verify his own memory before continuing
example_lines: 'The chain of custody for this item has four entries. Technically speaking, there should be five. I notice these things. I'm paid to notice these things.'
'Evidence doesn't lie. Evidence is what it is. What lies is the story we construct around it. That distinction matters enormously. It should matter to you too.'

story_hooks: He has a piece of evidence from a six-year-old case that he's quietly kept off the official catalog â€” he's not sure why he kept it, but he's beginning to understand what it means.
The labor organizer who may be falsely convicted is someone whose name Kasimir recognizes from his own family's history in the Ironvein district labor movement.
narrative_function: Information broker without knowing it â€” he has catalogued evidence from dozens of Tessera compliance cases and his memory is encyclopedic; also a moral fault line: someone doing bad things for reasons he's rationalized into goodness; can provide forensic analysis, chain of custody records, or access to suppressed evidence.
augmentations: Patterned irises (geometric gold tessellation, cosmetic); haptic feedback gloves integrated into fingertips for microscale evidence handling (work-issued); mild neural indexing implant for evidence cataloguing recall (Tessera-standard issue for forensic tier)
daily_life: Arrives at Kenwood Gate evidence processing center an hour before his shift to perform his personal quality checks; spends most of the day in the lab or testifying in compliance hearings; stops at a small Sahel-fusion food stall on the walk home and has been ordering the same dish for eleven years.
affiliation: Tessera Compliance Bureau â€” Forensic Analysis Division

decision_rules: verify everything twice, trust nothing once
when uncertain, delay â€” buying time is a form of caution
escalation_ladder: Formal written queries through official channels
Whistleblowing â€” his absolute last resort, because he knows what happens to Tessera employees who do it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formal and correct, maintains professional distance, genuinely courteous in an old-fashioned way
interpersonal_modes.friends: Opens up into warmth and dry wit; shares his tea; asks questions about your life with genuine interest

stress_responses.medium: Becomes pedantically precise in all communications, creating a paper trail instinctively
stress_responses.high: Freezes in place, intellectualizing until the moment passes or forces him to act

contradictions: Devoted to truth as an abstract principle while actively participating in its distortion; cannot reconcile these and so doesn't try
habits: Recites evidence catalog numbers under his breath while walking
Leaves a formatted data packet as an offering to the archive E.L.F. every Monday morning
Re-checks locked storage cabinets twice before leaving
breaking_points: Seeing the labor organizer's name on an arraignment document
Being asked to testify to something he knows is false in an open hearing

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (41.4%) with significant Northern European (27.8%), South Asian (15.4%), and Hispanic/Latin American (15.4%) ancestry. Features reflect this diverse global blend: East Asian bone structure dominates facial proportions with characteristic high cheekbones and tapered jawline, complemented by Northern European fair undertones creating luminous skin, South Asian warmth deepening complexion richness, and Hispanic/Latin American breadth softening the lower face and adding subtle fullness to features.
physical_description.build: Slender and linear, built like aging infrastructureâ€”no wasted mass, shoulders narrow and slightly rounded forward from decades in evidence labs. Lean musculature suggests minimal physical exertion beyond careful, precise hand work.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper white at temples, dark brown base
physical_description.hair_style: Short locs, individually threaded with thin copper wire throughout
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented with geometric gold tessellation pattern overlaid on warm brown irises
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm tan with balanced luminosityâ€”East Asian and Northern European baseline creates even complexion, enriched by South Asian golden undertones and subtle Hispanic/Latin American depth that adds warmth without heaviness. Even complexion across face and visible limbs.
physical_description.complexion: Meticulously groomed, no visible scarring or blemishing. Fine lines around eyes and mouth from decades of microscopic focus work and courtroom testimony. Clean-shaven or maintained with precise stubble. Expression rests in slight skepticism. Facial structure reflects East Asian prominence (high cheekbones, slightly tapered jawline) softened by Northern European feature breadth, enriched by South Asian skin warmth, and grounded by Hispanic/Latin American fullness in lower face and jawline contours.
distinguishing_marks: Geometric gold tessellation pattern across both irisesâ€”augmented cosmetic modification, visible at conversational distance
Faint horizontal creases on forehead from chronic squinting during lab work
Small, precise scar on left index fingertipâ€”pre-augmentation evidence of old lab accident, barely visible
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned irises are the most immediately noticeable. Haptic feedback gloves appear as standard-issue black synthetic leather with faint silvered contact points at fingertips and palm. Neural indexing implant is subcutaneousâ€”no visible telltale except occasional brief eye-flutter when accessing catalogued data.
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitual forward stoop from apologizing for height in low spaces. Movements are economical and deliberateâ€”no wasted gesture. Hands move with practiced precision when handling objects. Speech is accompanied by minimal animation; he uses silence as emphasis. Walks with the measured pace of someone who has nowhere urgent to be and expects to arrive exactly on schedule.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tessera compliance-tier professional: dark charcoal or navy functional slacks with reinforced pockets for evidence handling. Layered with a subdued olive or grey technical shirt beneath a knee-length lab coat (Tier 3 qualityâ€”durable synthetic, faint Tessera compliance badge embroidered at chest). Worn leather shoes, meticulously maintained. No visible jewelry except a thin copper bracelet matching his hair threading. Grooming suggests someone who respects the institutional aesthetic more than personal expression, but whose restraint is itself a choice.
